outcome: admission to the intensive care unit
cohort: Women younger than 20 years of age who delivered in a tertiary care hospital
finding: The most frequent indications for cesarean section in nulliparas with a single cephalic term pregnancy and spontaneous labor (Robson group 1) were abnormal cardiotocographic findings, arrest of descent, and arrest of dilation.
mod_finding: The study describes cesarean section rates in different Robson classification groups but does not directly compare outcomes based on mode of delivery.
